name: tiktok-agent
description: Twelve Claude skills for TikTok: three-layer hooks (spoken, on-screen, first visual) scored against 20 formulas, timed scripts, a caption linter that counts UTF-16 units, keyword maps from pasted search suggestions, a manual trend workflow with a snapshot analyser, retention from TikTok Studio exports, a swipe-file ranker, comment reply drafts, repurposing, a profile rubric, a weekly plan and a humanizer. No scraping, nothing posted for you.
